text:
alex: Quick check — our canary for runtime v3.1 + sdk 2.8 just tripped an odd latency tail on longseq (seen in EU). Anyone else seeing this?

mira: saw a small bump around 02:14 UTC, linked to a burst of `kvcache` misses. Not sure if it's model-specific or runtime hotpath.

samir: pinging deploybot logs

deploybot: Deploy report: canary/llama3q-v1 -> runtime-3.1 (canary fraction 5%). Observed 24 reqs with >95th percentile latency 1.6s. No errors.

jen: do we have any QA toggles enabled? I thought we had `prefetch_kvcache` off for that canary.

mira: QA toggle is off. I ran a quick replay against prod traffic subset, small increase in token generation time when sequence>1024

alex: rolling hypothesis — runtime 3.1 kernel choose path falls back to slower matmul for that sequence length with q4_1 quant. Could be an autotuned kernel mismatch.

samir: adding telemetry: `kvcache_miss_rate`, `kernel_path` tag, `quant_profile`. Will attach graphs.

mira: ops-bot note: attaching proposed mitigation — soft-pin runtime on that model group to runtime-3.0 for EU region while we triage. Expected impact: ~2% capacity shift. :warning:

alex: +1 for soft-pin. Does deploybot support regional soft-pin? I think only routing policy updates do.

jen: deploybot can add an override to pinlist for `eu-west-1` model group for next 30m, requires `@mira` or `@alex` approval.

alex: approving now. please implement and run smoke tests.

mira: done — deploybot triggered: `pin-exempt override` for models: llama3q-v1 in eu-west-1 -> runtime-3.0, ttl 30m. smoke tests started.

deploybot: Action: pin-exempt override applied by mira. Smoke: ok (generate/sanity x20). Routing updated.

jen: monitoring — tail latency back to baseline in eu-west. I'm going to open a short postmortem note with rollback conditions and checklist for lifting the pin.

mira: for release notes: add entry under "Known runtime compat" — runtime 3.1 may have long-sequence latency regressions with q4_1 on llama3q; recommended temp workaround: regional soft-pin to 3.0. Will draft.

alex: we'll keep this pinned until we have a kernel-shim patch or better kernel selection heuristics. If telemetry shows error rate or P99 > 2x baseline, escalate to rollback.

samir: uploading graphs and kernel traces to the ticket: LINK: https://redwood.example/p/INC-4532

jen: thanks. tagging SRE for post-deploy runbook update. @eng-runtime FYI.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window note — this is a non-blocking soft-pin; if extended beyond 2 hours, schedule change advisory.

alex: ok closing for now. We'll reconvene at +45m unless noise increases. :thumbsup:
